headline: Federal agencies must post a short, plain-language summary of each proposed rule online and link to it in the rule notice.
what_it_does: When a federal agency announces a proposed rule, the notice must now include a web address for a summary of that rule. The summary must be 100 words or fewer and written in plain language. It must be posted on regulations.gov.

who_it_affects.how: They must write a plain-language summary of 100 words or fewer for each proposed rule, post it on regulations.gov, and include its web address in the rule notice.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the public who follow or comment on proposed federal rules
who_it_affects.how: They can find a short, plain-language summary of each proposed rule on regulations.gov.

when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not state a separate start date; the law was enacted July 25, 2023.
